THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: 4/1/Acqtn/93/ High waltage. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2020/HW/207. I do hereby give notice, under sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired:

Three (03) allotments of Land from Lot 01 to 03 in Extent of 0.1609 Hectares of land, depicted in Cadastral Plan No. 420202 Block No. 07 Sheet No. 10, Dated 17th February, 2023, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Kurunegala District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Mahiella in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 713, Mahiella (North) of the

Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mallawapitiya in the District of Kurunegala, in the North Western Province: 01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Dippitiyawatta; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.0001 Hectare. North: Lot No. 02; East: Lot No. 03; South: Lot No. 03 and 04; West: Lot No. 02. 02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Dippitiyawatta; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.1525 Hectare. PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.

No. 420202 Block 07 sheet No. 08 Lot No. 223 and Cadastral Map No. 420202 Block No. 07 sheet No. 02 Lot No. 124; West: No. 717 Pallegattuwana Grama Niladhari Division. 03. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Dippitiyawatta; Claimant: Dewatha Pejalage Wattuwage Mutuwa alas Dewapaksha Chandrasena; Extent: 0.0083 Hectare. North: Lot No 02 and Cadastral Map No 420204 Block No. 01; East: Cadastral Map No. 420204 Block No. 01; South: Lot No. 04; West: Lot No. 01 and 02. All persons who claim ownership, interest or any other connection to the aforesaid lands hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me on 20.05.2024 at 10.00 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat.

And further, you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing in duplicate before 13.05.2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
gfg W.P.C.N. PATHIRANA, Divisional Secretary / Land Acquiring Officer, Mallawapitiya. Divisional Secretariat, Mallawapitiya. 13th November, 2023. EOG 03-0062
